title: Wan2.2 Seamless Loop Video
short_description: Generate short seamless-loop videos (first-last-frame I2V) on RunPod Serverless.
description: Image-to-video with Wan2.2 I2V rapid (14B GGUF): the start image is used as both first and last frame, so the clip loops seamlessly on player repeat. Returns the video as base64 MP4.
